data.name: Roommate Lover: Love in Progress
data.detailed_description:
Storyline / Characters

《Roommate Lovers: Love in Progress》is a first-person live-action video dating game. In the story, you'll experience choices and challenges in both your career and personal life alongside four beautiful women.

The story is set against a realistic workplace and everyday life backdrop. You'll play a young urbanite with a hidden identity, renting out an extra room in your apartment to alleviate the pressure of a mortgage. By chance, you'll spark romances with your female boss (Yang Yan), a dance streamer tenant (An Xiaotang), your college sweetheart working as a housekeeper (Li Zhixuan), and your childhood friend next door (Lin Xia).

Every choice you make will change the course of the story—different characters will display different emotions and values, ultimately leading to multiple endings.

Who will ultimately stay by your side?

The aloof and powerful female CEO boss: Yang Yan, cold to others but gentle only towards you—she simply likes you?

Dance streamer tenant: An Xiaotang, I only rely on you, can I take care of you for the rest of my life?

Li Zhixuan, a college sweetheart who works part-time as a housekeeper, desperately hopes to reconcile with her boyfriend. Why didn't they get together back then?

My childhood sweetheart, the girl next door: Lin Xia, can I only be your little sister?

Highlights

Immersive first-person romance game

The game unfolds entirely from a first-person perspective, immersing you in the story and forcing you to make crucial choices throughout a series of progressively unfolding events. From heartwarming and comforting everyday life as a roommate, to your female boss's repeated heroic rescues, to a heart-fluttering romantic date with your first love, to the ambiguous and tantalizing moments of attraction, you will personally experience and freely choose your own path, gradually leading to your unique ending. This is not just a dating simulation, but a story about choices, infatuation, and growth.

In this romance game, every decision you make will influence the plot, unlocking your unique storyline! We've meticulously crafted different story branches and varied endings, allowing you to experience the game repeatedly and fully explore all the possibilities of this heartwarming journey. Each chapter contains a hidden epilogue and surprise videos, adding more detail and emotion to your simulated romance experience. Those seemingly insignificant choices may even trigger mysterious hidden easter eggs—perhaps a sweet encounter never before revealed, perhaps a heroine's unspoken secret, or even more surprises waiting for you to discover…

The game features live-action performances by popular bloggers and professional actors, whose natural and genuine acting, coupled with high-definition and exquisite visuals, makes you feel as if you've personally stepped into a real love story, immersing you in every thrill of romance. Four adorable female protagonists will accompany you to unlock an immersive and heartwarming romantic experience.

We've partnered with professional film directors to create this production using top-tier film-level shooting and production standards. We meticulously depict every expression, movement, and interactive detail, delivering an ultra-high-definition visual experience that makes you feel like you're having a face-to-face conversation with your dream girl. We present a unique romantic feast that combines cinematic quality with highly interactive elements.

About Us

We are the developers of LumaGate. We are always focused on creating captivating narratives and immersive story experiences for players, allowing them to experience deeper and more genuine emotional resonance within the game. We cherish every player's experience and feedback. In the future, we will continue to dedicate ourselves to bringing you more games that resonate with your soul, and we look forward to exploring a longer journey together in this world full of stories and emotions.
